items.title: Fifteen jailed for life over involvement in Sri Lanka attacks that killed more than 260
items.description: Fifteen men have been convicted for their involvement in the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings which killed more than 260 people in Sri Lanka.

items.title: Doctors warn of 'exponential' rise in e-scooter and scrambler bike injuries
items.description: Injuries related to e-scooters and scrambler motorbikes in Ireland are rising at an "exponential rate" and "stretching" an already overstretched system, experts have warned.

items.title: Doctor was 'supervisor' of killings during Rwanda genocide, court hears
items.description: A doctor is accused of being a party to six genocide murders, including the stoning to death of a taxi driver and the killing of a woman and her child.

items.title: Converse apologises and removes ad after backlash
items.description: Converse, the American footwear brand, has apologised for an ad which critics said evoked Ku Klux Klan imagery, saying it recognised why the image was "deeply upsetting".

items.title: Infantino says he's 'open' to talks about FIFA reform in letter to football chiefs
items.description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino has written to football chiefs across the globe saying he is open to talks about reforming the organisation, while affirming his commitment to remain in post.
